sourceChecks.title: A wearable artificial kidney for patients with end-stage renal disease
sourceChecks.excerpt: The trial was stopped after the seventh subject
sourceChecks.paraphrase: A FDA-approved 24-hour human wearable hemodialysis pilot demonstrated solute clearance and fluid/electrolyte homeostasis in five of seven completing subjects, but stopped early for device issues.
sourceChecks.limitations: This is a dialysis prototype, not a complete kidney replacement: no glomerular/tubular/endocrine function, long-term implantation, or freedom from power/anticoagulation is established.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: wearable artificial kidney human clinical trial dialysis proof of concept full functions

sourceChecks.title: Induction of immune tolerance in living related human leukocyte antigen-matched kidney transplantation: A phase 3 randomized clinical trial
sourceChecks.excerpt: Fifteen (75%) reached the primary study endpoint of IS-free for >2 years
sourceChecks.paraphrase: A phase 3 trial in 20 selected HLA-matched sibling recipients found 15 remained immunosuppression-free for more than two years after donor-cell treatment; four restarted immunosuppression.
sourceChecks.limitations: Small selected matched-donor group and limited follow-up; not permanent universal tolerance and not elimination of all rejection, infection, or malignancy risks.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: kidney transplantation donor specific immune tolerance phase 3 immunosuppression withdrawal trial

sourceChecks.title: The Kidney Failure Risk Equation for prediction of end stage renal disease in UK primary care: An external validation and clinical impact projection cohort study
sourceChecks.paraphrase: A four-variable KFRE model was externally evaluated in 35,539 people with CKD and showed 5-year discrimination C-statistic 0.924 after calibration adjustment.
sourceChecks.limitations: This is discrimination, not >95% accuracy; cohort had eGFR below 60 (CKD stages G3+), one UK region, and did not validate an imaging panel or 5–10-year prediction in early CKD.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: kidney failure prediction biomarker panel five-year ESRD risk accuracy validation primary care CKD

sourceChecks.title: A preventive care strategy to reduce moderate or severe acute kidney injury after major surgery (BigpAK-2); a multinational, randomised clinical trial
sourceChecks.excerpt: moderate or severe AKI occurred in 84 (14·4%) patients
sourceChecks.paraphrase: A multinational randomized trial found a biomarker-triggered care bundle reduced moderate/severe AKI after major surgery from 22.3% to 14.4% in high-risk adults.
sourceChecks.limitations: It did not prevent all AKI and studied major surgery; it does not establish universal prevention across ICU, sepsis, or all contrast settings, nor elimination of mortality/costs.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: randomized trial universal acute kidney injury prevention high risk surgery contrast ICU sepsis

sourceChecks.title: In vivo base editing rescues ADPKD in a humanized mouse model
sourceChecks.paraphrase: A single AAV9-delivered base-editor treatment corrected a specific Pkd1 variant and delayed cyst growth in humanized ADPKD mouse models; authors describe the work as preclinical.
sourceChecks.limitations: No human safety or efficacy, complete cyst cessation, normal human kidney architecture, or prevention of ESRD without tolvaptan/transplant has been demonstrated.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: ADPKD one time gene editing pathway therapy stop cyst growth humanized mouse primary study

sourceChecks.title: Systematic production of human kidney organoids for transplantation in porcine kidneys during ex vivo machine perfusion
sourceChecks.locator: Results: Human kidney organoids persist in porcine kidneys after in vivo transplantation
sourceChecks.excerpt: Human kidney organoids persist in porcine kidneys after in vivo transplantation
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Researchers infused human pluripotent-stem-cell kidney organoids into porcine kidneys; transplanted organoid-derived cells remained viable for up to 48 hours in a preclinical same-animal model.
sourceChecks.limitations: This is short-term organoid engraftment in pig kidneys, not a patient-specific, fully vascularized, functional bioprinted kidney; no human implantation or replacement function is shown.
sourceChecks.searchQuery: 3D bioprinted kidney organoids transplant vascularized functional human kidney primary study
